text:
Type: three-seat sofa bed
Use: seating, sleeping guests; living room, guest room, studio
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: removable white fabric cover, pull-out bed, loose cushions
Colors: off-white, warm white
Shape: low sloped arms, five loose square back cushions, tight seat, skirted base down to the floor, long and soft
Feel: airy, fresh, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, linen, pale grey and beige textiles; Scandinavian, coastal or minimalist rooms

product.name: HOLMSUND
product.description: Cover made of durable cotton with a fine, smooth texture.
